interface_definitions.ConnectorHarness: Runs one upstream simulator, the restreamer initiator, restreamer acceptors, and ten downstream customer initiators to measure latency and reject behavior.
interface_definitions.DownstreamAcceptorGateway: Accepts up to 10 FIX 4.4 customer sessions and rejects non-market-data messages.
interface_definitions.FanoutEngine: Routes book events to subscribed sessions with low allocation and backpressure handling.
interface_definitions.MarketDataBookStore: Stores latest in-memory book state per instrument without persistence.
interface_definitions.SubscriptionRegistry: Maps downstream session IDs to requested instruments and all-symbol subscriptions.
interface_definitions.UpstreamMarketDataGateway: Connects as one FIX 4.4 initiator and normalizes PrimeXM market-data messages into in-memory book events.

receiving_normalization: normalization map such as XAUUSD# -> XAUUSD

required_inputs_before_dev: PrimeXM/cTrader production rules of engagement beyond working defaults
Target repository path for Artio/Aeron/Agrona implementation
cTrader FIX44 dictionary copied to target repo resources
